title: Small persistent notes API

requirements.description: Create notes with a nonempty text of at most 200 characters. Store in SQLite and assign an integer id.
Read a note by id. Return 404 for a missing id. Notes persist across application restarts.

acceptance_criteria.then: Return 422 and do not create a note.
Return 200 with id and text, including after app restart.

constraints: Use FastAPI, Pydantic and standard-library sqlite3.
Expose app:app and start with uvicorn app:app.
Use NOTES_DB environment variable for SQLite path, default notes.db.
Include pytest developer tests with temporary SQLite files and a README.
No authentication, external network or third-party package installation.
